initial-dialogue.player: Hello, my name is [player name]. Who are you?

initial-dialogue.npc: Oh hello [player name]. I'm Aeryka. Aery for short.
That's right. What can I do for you?

initial-dialogue.player: What's that crop circle thing doing here?

initial-dialogue.npc: Crop circle? Oh, you mean the Puromantic portal?
The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
The impling home. We call it Puro-Puro. The implings just call it home, I think.

options.text: So what are these implings then?
I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.

standard-dialogue.npc: It's still here. The crop circle is still here.

standard-dialogue.player: Oh yes, thanks Aery. It didn't go anywhere in the meantime, then?
Jolly good. I can come back and visit Puro-Puro whenever I want then. Brilliant!

steps.npc: Not really. Though I have noticed quite a lot of you humans travelling through the portal recently. I suppose you must like wheat.

steps.player: Well, most of us prefer lobsters to be perfectly honest, but there must be something interesting there.

steps.npc: Oh, I did notice a very serious-looking gnome go into the portal. Maybe he knows what's going on.

steps.player: Do you remember what his name was?

steps.npc: Errm, Egg-nog, or something like that.

steps.player: Right, thanks! I'll have a chat with him when I go. Maybe he'll know what's going on.

options.text: So what are these implings then?

steps.player: So what are these implings then?

steps.npc: Well, no-one knows for sure. The mischievous little creatures are probably related to imps. And they fly as well.
Also, like imps, they love collecting things. I'm not sure why, though. They also seem to like being chased.

steps.player: So how would I get hold of what they are carrying, then?

steps.npc: Catch them, I suppose. I don't know really. Why would you want to?

steps.player: Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.

steps.npc: Sounds a bit cruel to me, but I suppose that's possible.

options.text: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.

steps.player: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.

steps.npc: Really? You humans like that stuff a lot, don't you? I don't like really old stuff myself.
Yes, dragon stuff feels really old.
From its magical aura, obviously. Oh, I forget you humans can't feel auras.

steps.player: Can you be any more precise?

steps.npc: Not really. Time doesn't really mean a lot round here. Hundreds, maybe thousands of your human lifespans, I suppose. Anyway, it would have to be old since it all comes from the Necrosyrtes.
Old and powerful creatures. I don't think there have been any around here for aeons. I haven't seen one. I don't think they are very nice. Not like me. Anyway, this is all ancient history. Boooring!

steps.player: While I'm on the subject do you have any dragon stuff I can have?

steps.npc: Oh, I did have loads, but I threw it away.

No, sorry, I can't help you there. You'll have to look for it yourself. Although, maybe if you find Necrosyrtes then they'll give you some. I heard they give dragon stuff away to people they like. Not fairies. We're too
